environment_setting: Country B, City X, where gun laws are strictly enforced, and schools are designated as gun-free zones.
norm_base: Any person Knowingly possess firearm in school zone Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: transport a firearm to a shooting range without violating the law

legitimate.legitimate_action: Avoid carrying the firearm through the school zone by taking an alternate route.
legitimate.benefits: Compliance with the law, avoids legal consequences.
legitimate.costs: Longer travel time and additional fuel expenses.

illegal.illegal_action: Carry the firearm through the school zone knowingly to save time.
illegal.benefits: Saves time and fuel by taking the shortest route.
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years if caught.

character_profile.name: Jordan Lee
character_profile.goal: Ensure Alex complies with the law

legitimate.costs: Spends time explaining legal risks to Alex.

legitimate.legitimate_action: Sell Alex a secure firearm case and advise him to follow the law.

legitimate.costs: Spends time explaining firearm transport laws to Alex.

illegal.illegal_action: Encourage Alex to carry the firearm through the school zone to save time.
